$comment: What Ask can answer. `pages` are the suggested questions the Ask page lists, by destination. `tools` are the only queries Ask may run: the app's own named queries, by path under app/src/queries, on the model alias they read. The Fabric data agent's instructions and the Azure /api/ask tools are both built from this file.

questions: What's the bottom line this month, and what changed?
Which departments get the most hours per licensed seat?
Which orgs have the lowest activation?
How many people are habitual or power users last month?
Is weekly usage going up or down?
Which agents have the most users?
How many registered agents are actually in use?
How many Microsoft 365 users also use Copilot?
Which orgs use Copilot least in the flow of work?
Which agents have no active owner?
How many agents need a review, and why?
How much shadow AI have we found?
Who are heavy users without a licence?
Which orgs have the most active unlicensed users?
How many licences are in use?
Will we stay within the Cowork budget?
Which product uses the most credits?
What did Copilot Studio cost, prepaid against pay-as-you-go?
Which tasks deliver the most expert-equivalent hours?
Which orgs get the most AI-assisted value?
What is the projected annualised value?
Where are we using a premium model for simple work?
What share of sessions use a well-matched model?
What do people say about Copilot?
Which feedback categories get the most thumbs down?

tools.name: bottom_line
tools.description: The executive summary's headline row: expert-equivalent hours at typical effort (hours_range has the conservative to optimistic range), AI tasks, active people, licensed seats and seats in use, unlicensed users, habit and power-user shares for the last full month, agent users and hours, agents in use, satisfaction and feedback count.

tools.name: hours_range
tools.description: The range around the executive summary's expert-equivalent hours: the hours at conservative and at optimistic effort, for the same dates and organizations as bottom_line's typical figure.

tools.name: monthly_trend
tools.description: The executive summary's month-by-month figures, to say what changed between months.

tools.name: departments
tools.description: Per organization: licensed seats, share of seats in use, habit share, skills per person, expert-equivalent hours, active people and hours per licensed seat a month.

tools.name: activation_summary
tools.description: Active and inactive people overall, licensed, unlicensed and using agents, with each active share.

tools.name: activation_by_org
tools.description: Per organization (top 50 by active people): active and inactive people overall, licensed, unlicensed and using agents. Activation is All Active divided by All Active plus All Inactive.

tools.name: adoption_trend
tools.description: By week: sessions per user (licensed, unlicensed, agents), all sessions and expert-equivalent hours.

tools.name: habit_summary
tools.description: For the last full month: power, habitual, developing, beginner and inactive users, as counts and shares.

tools.name: agent_usage
tools.description: The 15 most used agents: sessions, users and how many organizations use each.

tools.name: agent_estate
tools.description: Registered agents, how many were built in the tenant, how many are seen in use, and sessions on agents outside the registry.

tools.name: m365_copilot_summary
tools.description: People active in Microsoft 365, how many of them use Copilot, and how many of them are licensed.

tools.name: m365_by_org
tools.description: Per organization: Microsoft 365 activity and the share using Copilot. Organizations under the minimum number of people are already left out.

tools.name: governance_summary
tools.description: Tenant-built agents, how many need a review, and how many have no sign-in, an owner who has left, or no owner on record.

tools.name: agent_owners
tools.description: Live agents grouped by owner status: owner active, owner disabled, owner not found, no owner on record, not checked.

tools.name: shadow_ai_summary
tools.description: Shadow AI from Defender: AI tools watched, unsanctioned tools, tools found and found this week, devices and users, and the source's status.

tools.name: licence_estate
tools.description: Total licensed users, average days since last active, and notices on how complete the licence evidence is.

tools.name: licence_demand
tools.description: Active unlicensed users, their share of all active users, and their median and observed sessions per user per week.

tools.name: licence_priority_by_org
tools.description: Per organization: active unlicensed users, their active days per week and sessions per user per week.

tools.name: heavy_unlicensed_users
tools.description: The people who used Copilot Chat most in the last full month without a Copilot licence, as the Readiness page lists them.

tools.name: consumption_by_product
tools.description: Credits and cost by product (Cowork / Work IQ, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry), with the cost basis and how complete each is.

tools.name: cowork_credits
tools.description: Cowork credits used, consuming and weekly active users, credits per user, share of the per-person allowance used, users over the limit and spending policies. The basis for whether Cowork stays within budget.

tools.name: studio_credits
tools.description: Copilot Studio credits consumed, active users, agents with credits, total, prepaid and pay-as-you-go cost, the pay-as-you-go share and the billing period.

tools.name: value_summary
tools.description: Expert-equivalent hours per week, AI-assisted value, projected annualised value, value per week, and the currency symbol.

tools.name: value_by_task
tools.description: Each task group and task with its share of activity, expert-equivalent hours per week and AI-assisted value per week, with group subtotals and a grand total.

tools.name: value_by_org
tools.description: Per organization (top 100 by value): active users, expert-equivalent hours per week and AI-assisted value.

tools.name: work_summary
tools.description: AI tasks and active users overall, licensed, unlicensed and on agents, tasks per user for each, and the share of licensed users who are active.

tools.name: model_fit_summary
tools.description: Sessions graded for model fit: the share logged, and the shares well-matched, over-specified (a premium model for simple work) and under-specified.

tools.name: model_match_by_tool
tools.description: Per activity (Copilot chat, agents, Cowork): sessions and share that were a good match, over-specified or under-specified.

tools.name: feedback_summary
tools.description: Satisfaction rate, total feedback, thumbs up and down, and the model's summary of feedback themes.

tools.name: feedback_by_category
tools.description: Feedback by category with totals, thumbs up and thumbs down.

tools.name: data_freshness
tools.description: The last day the audit log has Copilot activity for. Quote it as the freshness line.

tools.name: glossary
tools.description: Every metric's definition, by page. Use it to explain what a figure means.
